headline: Glide.id Beta Launches First Carrier-Native Cryptographic Authentication Across AT&T, T-Mobile and Verizon as AI Fraud Reaches Record Highs
summary: SAN FRANCISCO, August 03, 2026--Glide.id, a digital identity security company, today announced the public beta with full US coverage and full commercial availability of MagicalAuth, its cryptographic authentication platform, across AT&T, T-Mobile, and Verizon on both iOS and Android — representing an alignment among the nation's three largest carriers around a hardware-rooted cryptographic trust anchor.
